title: codiaeum inophyllum
intro: Codiaeum inophyllum, commonly known as the 'Variegated Leaf Tree' or 'Kadamba', is a tropical plant native to the coastal regions of the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and rheumatism, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Codiaeum inophyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit antioxidant, antispasmodic, and antipyretic effects. Traditional medicine practitioners have used Codiaeum inophyllum for centuries to address various health conditions, leveraging its therapeutic potential to promote overall well-being.
